messages:
Maya (Support): FYI — Lumos Procurement emailed: they will not accept an invoice without their internal requisition number and vendor code. They want the invoice held until they provide a 'PR' (purchase requisition) and the e-invoice metadata in their template. Attached screenshot of their email.

Jonah (Billing): Ok — I can put the invoice on hold. Which invoice ID? Also do we have the contract/legal SOW attached? Their finance team sometimes requires cost center.

Maya (Support): Invoice is INV-2026-078 (for March usage). Contract SOW uploaded to Zendesk ticket 8237. Customer provided vendor id LUM-9982 but said procurement will only accept our invoice if it contains: PR#, cost center, and their GL code.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-078 status changed to: ON_HOLD (reason: REQ_PR_AND_VENDOR_INFO) by Jonah at 2024-04-28T15:14:10Z

Asha (Acct Mgmt): @Carla — can you confirm the exact PR format? We can either reissue a proforma invoice for procurement or annotate the current invoice with their fields. Which do you prefer?

Lumos Procurement - Carla (Customer): Thanks. We need a formal invoice with our PR in the header and our GL code in the line-item memo. Template attached. Please also include 'e-invoice: true' and the following fields: requisition_number, approver_name, cost_center. We can supply PR within 48 hours.

Jonah (Billing): Copying process: 1) create proforma with their template 2) tag original INV-2026-078 as 'pending PR' 3) when PR arrives, update invoice and release for billing. I'll also note hold in accounting (SAP ref pending).

Maya (Support): I'll reply to their procurement and request the PR and confirm expected ETA. Also offering to generate the proforma now so procurement can see the format.

Asha (Acct Mgmt): If PR doesn't arrive in 72h, do we want to escalate to sales ops? We risk delaying month-end close. Recommend escalation path: sales ops -> legal if they demand contract changes.

Jonah (Billing): Agreed. I've set a 72h follow-up reminder and flagged month-end potential impact. Tagging internal doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/procurement-hold-guidelines — use reason code PROC_REQ.

Maya (Support): Customer replied — PR expected tomorrow morning. Will update thread when we receive it. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled for INV-2026-078 in 72h (2024-05-01T15:14:10Z)

(Next day) Maya (Support): Received PR 2024-LL-556 from Carla (screenshot). She confirms GL code 4532-OP. Forwarding to @Jonah to update invoice.

Jonah (Billing): Updated INV-2026-078 with requisition_number=2024-LL-556 and GL=4532-OP, set e-invoice=true. Reissued PDF sent to Carla and accounting. Invoice released for processing. billing-bot updated status: RELEASED.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-078 status changed to: RELEASED (processed at 2024-04-29T10:03:30Z)

Asha (Acct Mgmt): Great — closing loop. Noted for month-end.

Maya (Support): Closing ticket in Zendesk and marking as resolved. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
